_instructions: The AI statement reader on the homepage. A visitor uploads a processing statement, Claude reads it on EPAY's own API, and the card shows what they are paying today. Same API the landing pages use (freestatementreview / consumerchoice / epaybonussignup), so there is one analyzer to maintain, one prompt, and no API key anywhere in this site.
_note_on_api: api_url is EPAY's deployed Netlify function. It takes a POST with multipart field `statement` and returns { ok, total_fees, total_volume, processor_name, statement_period, total_fees_source }. If it is ever redeployed elsewhere, change it here and on the landing pages.
_note_on_privacy: The file is sent straight from the visitor's browser to that API over HTTPS. It is never stored by this website and never touches Netlify Forms. Keep the disclaimer honest about that.
heading: Upload it. Get the real number.
body: Drop in a recent processing statement and our reader pulls out what you are actually paying — including the fees on the back pages.
drop_hint: or drag it here — PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB

result.label: You're currently paying
result.quote_hint: Keep this number — it links your statement to your rate review.

failed.heading: We couldn't read that one
failed.body: Some statements are scans the reader can't make out. Send it to us and a person will go through it line by line.

too_big: That file is over {max} MB. Try a smaller PDF, or send it to us and we'll look at it.
wrong_type: That file type isn't supported. Use a PDF, JPG or PNG.
disclaimer: Your statement goes straight to EPAY's reader over an encrypted connection and is used only for your rate review. It is never stored on this website.
